add.title: Let a leaf: true page name a few children to show in the site sidebar anyway (e.g. AI → Queue, Now)
add.why: The AI page is leaf:true so its 17 children stay out of the sidebar, but then the owner could not find the task queue from the sidebar (2026-10-24: 'there's no link to it'). Today it is all children or none; Sidebar.js:185 already walks leaf children for the filter box, so a short list option could reuse that.
